policy: Existing live Drive SOP + six central rules + 17 numbered Skills + Superpowers + Observer take precedence. All three optional adapters are guidance only; no runtime/auto-install/permission grant.

adapters.name: curated-3kings-change-quality

adapters.name: curated-3kings-report-diagram
adapters.use: Generate static read-only/report-only diagram specifications or exports using tools separately authorized for a particular task.

adapters.name: curated-3kings-report-slides
adapters.use: Source-backed editable PowerPoint report authoring if a separate presentation tool is available and explicitly used.
